GOLD RUSH 1898

<PLAYER TOO SLOW/NOT MOVING BUG? CLICK HERE>

---

Why sell shovels when you can rush for gold?

Controls

WASD or Arrow Keys[D-Pad]Move horizontally
J or Z[A]Jump / Interact
K or X[B]Drop bombs
Space or Enter[Start]Interact with UI

Tips

  • Your progress will be saved after each run. You can refresh and continue where you left off.
  • Recommended upgrades:
    • get 1 or 2 cart capacity upgrades early on
    • HEAD START will give you a huge boost per run
    • SHOVEL BIZ + bonus rounds in the late game will help you achieve the win condition sooner than you think!

Known Bugs

There is a game-breaking bug where the player gets stuck and the screen doesn't move at all.

If this happens to you, please click here to play on the patched build.

Original Soundtrack

Credits

Code, art and music handcrafted by Alphonsus. You can follow me on Twitter/X.

Made in 10 days for GBJAM14.
